headline: Capeco Cuts Peru Construction Growth Forecast to 9.2% for 2026
summary: Peru's Construction Chamber (Capeco) has lowered its 2026 construction growth projection to 9.2%, citing risks from the El Niño weather phenomenon and a lack of housing subsidies.
why: Construction sector activity serves as a primary driver of domestic capital expenditure, employment, and overall economic growth in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Construction
impacts.why: Downwardly revised growth projections signal tempered economic activity and reduced project volumes for builders.
